scope: Retire the post-NGE recurring Bestine, Dearic, and Keren GCW city-invasion scheduler and runtime authority while preserving Publish 14 faction standing/rank, static faction bases, PRE-CU open-world battlefields, mission terminals, and reusable city-event assets.

findings: The pinned Publish 14 reference retains battlefield locations, faction recruiters, and GCW object assets.

The pinned reference has a reusable gcw_city_spawner object template but no active Bestine/Dearic/Keren construction-and-assault controller or recurring planet scheduler equivalent to systems.gcw.gcw_city.
The live-source city-invasion creature rows use later level-60/90/110 NGE profession classes and therefore cannot govern PRE-CU ground GCW gameplay.
